title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Several Opinions on Strengthening and Improving the Supervision and Inspection Work of People's Courts
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Several Opinions on Strengthening and Improving the Supervision and Inspection Work of People's Courts

Fa Fa [2010] No. 44

High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Several Opinions on Strengthening and Improving the Supervision and Inspection Work of People's Courts of the Supreme People's Court are hereby issued to you for earnest implementation.

October 29, 2010

Several Opinions on Strengthening and Improving the Supervision and Inspection Work of People's Courts

With a view to deeply advancing the timely and effective implementation of the Party's line, principles, and policies, the major decisions and deployments of the People's Courts, important special work, and matters assigned by leaders at all levels through instructions, and to promoting the scientific development of the work of the People's Courts, the following opinions are hereby put forward on strengthening and improving the supervision and inspection (hereinafter referred to as "inspection") work of the People's Courts.

I. Fully Recognize the Importance of the Inspection Work of the People's Courts

(1) Importance of Inspection Work. Inspection work is an important component of the work of the People's Courts and an important method for strengthening the management of the People's Courts. It is an inevitable requirement for the People's Courts to implement the Party's line, principles, and policies, to promote serving the overall situation and administering justice for the people, to implement major decisions and deployments and matters assigned by leaders through instructions, and to promote the transformation of judicial work style. People's Courts at all levels must, from the perspective of the rise or fall of the people's judicial cause, fully recognize the importance and necessity of strengthening and improving the inspection work of the People's Courts under the new situation, place inspection work on the important agenda, strive to achieve the work objectives of scientific inspection, efficient inspection, and clean inspection, and better promote the scientific development of all work of the People's Courts through the scientific development of inspection work.

II. Further Clarify the Functions and Tasks of the Inspection Work of the People's Courts

(2) Work Functions. The functions of the inspection work of the People's Courts are mainly reflected in three aspects: First, promoting the implementation of work. Through supervision and inspection, vigorously promote the implementation of major decisions and deployments of the People's Courts and matters assigned by leaders through instructions. Second, assisting scientific decision-making. Through supervision and inspection, promptly understand the situation of decision implementation, grasp the problems existing in implementation, strengthen guidance, promote implementation, correct deviations, and improve decisions. Third, promoting the transformation of work style. Through supervision and inspection, urge the inspected units to focus on work effectiveness, improve work efficiency, and solve practical problems.

(3) Main Tasks. The inspection work of the People's Courts is the supervision and inspection of major decisions and deployments of the People's Courts, important special work, and matters assigned by relevant organs such as the superior or同级 Party committees and people's congresses standing committees and their leaders, the superior People's Court and its leaders, or the leaders of the court itself. It includes both special inspection and decision inspection.

III. Strive to Achieve the "Three Transformations" of Inspection Work

(4) Transform Work Functions. The functions of inspection work shall be transformed from purely promoting the implementation of work to combining promoting the implementation of work with assisting scientific decision-making and promoting the transformation of work style. While promoting the smooth implementation of major decisions and deployments, through inspection, grasp relevant information to provide reliable basis for leaders' scientific decision-making; through inspection, urge the inspected units to seek truth and be pragmatic, and improve efficiency.

(5) Transform Work Focus. The focus of inspection work shall be transformed from purely special inspection to combining special inspection with decision inspection. Change the situation of focusing only on the inspection of matters assigned by leaders through instructions (especially instructions assigned cases) while neglecting the inspection of major decisions and deployments, and vigorously promote the implementation of major decisions and deployments of the People's Courts.

(6) Transform Work Mode. The work mode of inspection shall be transformed from purely passive inspection to combining passive inspection with active inspection. While adhering to the inspection work principle of "act upon orders, do nothing without orders", for special inspection, promptly grasp progress and actively report feedback. For decision inspection, intervene early in the project initiation stage, promptly propose inspection suggestions and plans; in the investigation stage, actively track and monitor the implementation situation in real time; in the summary stage, actively act, objectively reflect the implementation situation and problems, and provide suggestions for improving work.

IV. Further Improve the Inspection Work System

(7) Establish and Improve the Leadership Responsibility System. A responsibility system shall be established where the main leader bears overall responsibility, and other leaders share responsibility according to their分工, forming a top-down responsibility chain for all levels and departments to implement tasks.

(8) Establish and Improve the Work Operation System. Clear provisions shall be made regarding the initiation and project establishment of inspection tasks, proposed handling and submission for approval, methods of transfer, urging procedures, feedback deadlines, reporting requirements, criteria for case closure, and confidential archiving, to ensure that inspection work has rules to follow and operates efficiently.

(9) Establish and Improve the Priority Handling System. For decision inspection matters that need to be studied by the Party Leadership Group meeting or the President's Office meeting, priority shall be given to scheduling them for study; for case inspection matters, priority shall be given to project initiation and timely assignment to the case handler to ensure lawful and timely conclusion.

(10) Establish and Improve the Reporting and Notification System. Strictly adhere to the determined deadlines and truthfully report inspection results to the relevant leading organs and leading comrades; regularly notify the situation of implementation of major decisions and deployments of the People's Courts and handling of matters assigned by leaders by People's Courts at all levels and various departments within the court.

(11) Establish and Improve the Inspection Work Evaluation System. In light of actual work, establish an inspection work evaluation system and incorporate inspection work into the court's internal performance evaluation system.

V. Further Innovate Inspection Work Methods

(12) Actively Innovate Inspection Work Methods. On the basis of strengthening telephone and written inspection, adopt flexible and diverse inspection work methods. Learn from the inspection work experience of the Party and government systems, carry out joint inspections, cross inspections, and on-site inspections for major decisions and deployments; actively conduct inspection research for common and trending issues, understand the real situation, identify problems, summarize experiences, and propose suggestions.

(13) Develop and Apply Inspection Work Software. Courts with conditions shall, based on local and unit realities, rely on technological means, actively develop inspection work software, advance inspection informatization, implement regional online inspection, and improve the quality and efficiency of inspection work.

VI. Further Improve the Inspection Work Network

(14) Improve the Inspection Work Network. Establish a top-down interactive working mechanism, gradually standardize the establishment of inspection institutions in courts at higher and lower levels, clarify the functions of inspection institutions, strengthen work exchanges between higher and lower courts, and build a consistent work pattern from top to bottom with unified functions. Establish a left-right cooperative working mechanism, establish a coordination mechanism between the inspection department and various departments within the court, establish a joint inspection mechanism between the inspection department and functional departments, establish an exchange mechanism between sister courts, and for matters of great importance or overlapping tasks, promptly communicate and coordinate to jointly study measures and methods to promote work implementation. Establish a working mechanism combining full-time and part-time staff, fully equip and strengthen full-time inspection staff, fully tap the potential of inspection department staff, focus on improving the theoretical level and business capabilities of inspection staff, and simultaneously set up part-time inspection work liaison officers in other departments within the court to assist in the implementation of inspection tasks.

VII. Further Strictly Enforce Discipline Requirements for Inspection Work

(15) Strictly Enforce Inspection Work Discipline. Inspection shall be carried out strictly in accordance with laws, policies, system regulations, and work procedures. The initiation and implementation of any inspection activity must be approved by the relevant leader; it is not allowed to initiate inspections without authorization, to interfere with case adjudication under the guise of inspection, or to deceive superiors or subordinates or engage in fraud for personal gain.

VIII. Effectively Strengthen Organizational Leadership for Inspection Work

(16) Strengthen Organizational Leadership. The Supreme People's Court and High People's Courts shall establish inspection work leading groups with the President or Executive Vice President as the group leader, relevant court leaders as deputy group leaders, and comprehensive administrative departments, personnel management departments, trial management departments, discipline inspection and supervision departments, and relevant trial business departments as member units, to provide strong organizational guarantees for strengthening and improving inspection work.

(17) Improve Institutional Setup. Further implement the requirements of the "Provisions on the Supervision and Inspection Work of People's Courts". High People's Courts shall establish specialized inspection work institutions; intermediate and grass-roots People's Courts with conditions may establish specialized inspection work institutions.

(18) Strengthen Staffing. Courts that have established specialized institutions shall fully equip and strengthen inspection work forces, selecting comrades with high political quality, strong work ability, and trial professional titles for inspection work posts; intermediate and grass-roots People's Courts that do not have conditions to establish specialized institutions shall, based on actual work, equip full-time or part-time inspection staff. Increase the exchange of inspection cadres; outstanding cadres from other departments within the court may be enriched into the inspection team, and comrades familiar with trial business in inspection posts may be exchanged to trial business departments.

(19) Focus on Business Training. The Supreme People's Court shall, as necessary, organize special training for inspection work and strengthen guidance to lower levels; each High People's Court shall correspondingly carry out inspection work training and guidance to lower levels, improve the quality of the inspection team, and enhance the level of inspection work.

(20) Provide Work Guarantees. Provide necessary work convenience for inspection work; important documents shall be issued to the inspection work department; inspection staff shall be allowed to attend important work meetings as non-voting participants; create conditions for inspection staff to accompany court leaders to go to the grassroots for investigation and inspection of work, so that inspection staff can grasp the overall work situation, identify the focal points of inspection work, and better perform their work duties.
